messages:
olivia: quick sync - Acme wants a unified onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. goal: private trial across all three, then public listing. need checklist for each cloud + SI touchpoints.

dan: high-level: Azure private offer = offer alias + manifest + webhook; GCP private listing = manifest + allowed_customer_ids + region constraints; AWS SaaS = listing JSON + entitlement mapping. SI (DeltaSys) will handle SSO and install verification.

samira: legal/ops note: create one-line user-facing copy that works across clouds. also include privacy line: we store usage metadata only (no raw prompts). legal will need trial duration & termination paragraph.

olivia: sample one-liner for partner: "Start a 30-day free trial of Redwood Inference (up to 75k tokens/month). By enrolling you accept Redwood's Marketplace Terms and Privacy Policy; we collect usage metadata for billing and analytics."

d an: ops checklist (short):
- Publisher IDs for each cloud
- Offer alias / manifest (s3/gcs/blob)
- Webhook endpoints (stub) with X-Marketplace-Signature
- Support contact + SI runbook link
- Data residency / region flags

marketplace-bot: templates: https://internal.re/marketplace/templates/multi-cloud-manifest and runbook sample at s3://redwood-marketplace/onboarding/acme/runbook-v1.md

samira: action items: dan = push manifests to cloud buckets + create offer aliases; olivia = finalize partner-facing paragraph and share with legal; i'll draft EULA delta and privacy paragraph by EOD. schedule handoff call once offer IDs are available.

olivia: preferred launch order: Azure private -> GCP private -> AWS SaaS public if metrics look good. keeps scope constrained.

dan: noted. I'll post OfferIDs and webhook test results here when ready.

samira: also flag PR timeline: SI onboarding window 2 weeks after private launch, then joint announcement if conversion >= 10%.

olivia: thanks all, will book partner handoff 9am PT tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
